nodes.label: Bespoke Hard-UI Widgets Pattern
nodes.rationale: Material's built-in component states (elevation, ripple, pill indicators) can't cleanly emulate the full-invert/hard-rule look, so segmented controls, nav, steppers, and primary buttons are written as bespoke widgets consuming AppThemeTokens directly instead of reskinned ChipTheme/NavigationBarTheme/FilledButtonTheme.

nodes.label: Literal Motion Principle
nodes.rationale: Motion budget is spent in exactly one place per interaction rather than scattered. New motion should be tied to something a lifter would literally recognize from training/competition (e.g. the judges' three-light call), not a generic fade/slide, and must respect MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations.

nodes.label: PLATFORM Visual Identity
nodes.rationale: App is framed as 'equipment, not a wellness app' for powerlifters logging sets mid-session; nothing should read soft/decorative (no pastels, no pill shapes, no gradient hero cards). Every color choice should trace back to something recognizable from a meet or gym floor, driving the competition-platform-under-stage-lighting identity.

nodes.label: Ramp Color Contrast Rule
nodes.rationale: Learned the hard way: a ramp color (rpeColor()/plate colors) must never be used as freestanding foreground text/icon color. The ramp's light end was tuned to pop against the dark theme's graphite background; reused directly as text on the light theme it became nearly invisible. Fix: keep color-coding inside a bordered swatch/accent bar with an outline and render real text in theme.colorScheme.onSurface, or compute text color from the swatch's own background brightness.

nodes.label: AppColors.rpeColor RPE Ramp
nodes.rationale: IPF-calibrated competition plate colors (5kg white, 10kg green, 15kg yellow, 20kg blue, 25kg red) are interpolated across RPE 1-10 because light-to-heavy plates map naturally onto low-to-high perceived training effort.

nodes.label: Zero Border Radius Decision
nodes.rationale: Deliberate change from an earlier 4px-radius iteration of the design system; the current PLATFORM identity is hard-edged, not softened, so buttons/cards/chips/plates/nav/inputs all use zero border radius.
